$comment: Queries and keyword lists for scripts/mine-literature.mjs. Edit freely; the script never needs changes for new topics.

arxiv: (abs:cancer OR abs:tumor OR abs:tumour OR abs:oncology OR abs:chemotherapy) AND (abs:"game theory" OR abs:"evolutionary game" OR abs:Stackelberg OR abs:"mean field game" OR abs:"mean-field game" OR abs:"replicator")

(abs:cancer OR abs:tumor OR abs:tumour OR abs:chemotherapy OR abs:"adaptive therapy") AND (abs:"optimal control" OR abs:"Hamilton-Jacobi" OR abs:Pontryagin OR abs:"dynamic programming" OR abs:"viability" OR abs:"reinforcement learning")

(abs:cancer OR abs:tumor OR abs:tumour OR abs:glioma OR abs:leukemia) AND (abs:"free boundary" OR abs:"Hele-Shaw" OR abs:"phenotype-structured" OR abs:"reaction-diffusion" OR abs:"branching process" OR abs:"integro-differential" OR abs:"Lotka-Volterra" OR abs:"selection-mutation")

(abs:"drug resistance" OR abs:"adaptive therapy" OR abs:"tumor-immune" OR abs:"tumour-immune" OR abs:immunotherapy) AND (abs:"mathematical model" OR abs:"differential equation" OR abs:"evolutionary dynamics")
europepmc: (cancer OR tumour OR tumor OR neoplasm) AND ("game theory" OR "evolutionary game" OR "Stackelberg" OR "mean field game" OR "replicator dynamics" OR "evolutionary dynamics" OR "adaptive therapy" OR "evolutionary therapy")
(cancer OR tumour OR tumor OR chemotherapy OR radiotherapy OR immunotherapy) AND ("optimal control" OR "Hamilton-Jacobi" OR "Pontryagin" OR "dynamic programming" OR "model predictive control")

(cancer OR tumour OR tumor OR glioma OR leukaemia OR leukemia OR metastasis) AND ("mathematical model" OR "mathematical modelling" OR "mathematical modeling") AND ("differential equation" OR "free boundary" OR "reaction-diffusion" OR "branching process" OR "phenotype-structured" OR "Lotka-Volterra" OR "partial differential")
openalex: (cancer OR tumor OR tumour) AND ("game theory" OR "evolutionary game" OR Stackelberg OR "mean field game" OR "adaptive therapy" OR "replicator dynamics")
(cancer OR tumor OR tumour OR chemotherapy) AND ("optimal control" OR "Hamilton-Jacobi" OR Pontryagin OR "dynamic programming")
(cancer OR tumor OR tumour OR glioma OR leukemia) AND ("free boundary" OR "Hele-Shaw" OR "phenotype-structured" OR "reaction-diffusion" OR "branching process" OR "integro-differential")
semanticscholar: (cancer | tumor | tumour) + ("game theory" | "evolutionary game" | Stackelberg | "mean field game" | "adaptive therapy")
(cancer | tumor | tumour | chemotherapy) + ("optimal control" | "Hamilton-Jacobi" | Pontryagin | "dynamic programming")
(cancer | tumor | tumour | glioma | leukemia) + ("free boundary" | "Hele-Shaw" | "phenotype-structured" | "reaction-diffusion" | "branching process")

required.$comment: A paper is kept only if its title+abstract matches at least one term from EACH group.

bonus.$comment: Extra score for terms close to the tour's core; weights add to the base score (number of distinct math terms matched).

themes.$comment: Keyword votes that map a paper to a tour chapter id (content/tours/*.yaml). The chapter with most votes wins; ties go to the first listed.
